run_vs_env_script: run the vs_env.py script with a target architecture and command to set up Visual Studio environment variables
review_vs_env_script: review the vs_env.py script that sets up Visual Studio environment and runs a command via subprocess
refactor_vs_env_script: refactor the vs_env.py script to replace shell=True subprocess call with a safer alternative
summarize_vs_env_script: summarize the vs_env.py script that selects Visual Studio version and executes a command in its environment
test_vs_env_script: test the vs_env.py script by passing a target architecture and a simple command like echo
